regenerate_when: openapi.yaml's cursor/page_size parameters, AssembleContextRequest.cursor, SearchMemoryResponse.next_cursor, ZoneItemsPage, or the StaleCursor/BadRequest error responses change -- this file is an extract, not an independent source of truth.
design_note: api-design-core M1: offset pagination is forbidden at the item counts in HLD Section 12D. Every pattern below is cursor-based; none accepts an offset/page-number parameter.

patterns.description: NOT classic pagination. HLD Section 7.1 models assemble as a single budget-fitted snapshot bounded by max_items<=500, not a paginated list. cursor lets a caller retrieve additional ranked candidates beyond the first page's budget fit without re-running retrieval, while keeping the snapshot's assembly_id and score basis stable.
patterns.request_field: cursor (string, nullable) -- absent on the first call
patterns.response_field: next_cursor (string, nullable) -- present when items_considered > items_returned
patterns.cap: max_items: integer, minimum 1, maximum 500, default 50 (hard server-side cap per HLD threat D-3)
patterns.same_scope_constraint: cursor is only valid within the SAME assembly_id it was issued for

patterns.description: Raw retrieval without assembly/budget-fitting; standard cursor-paginated results.
patterns.response_field: next_cursor (string, nullable), required field on SearchMemoryResponse

patterns.description: Cursor-paginated admin browse of a zone's items (FR-009, FR-002 -- Episodic zone's own cursor-pagination rule generalized to every zone's admin browse per api-design-core M1).
request_fields: page_size (integer, minimum 1, maximum 500, default 50, query param)
